name: markdown-to-pdf
title: Markdown to PDF
description: Turn the Markdown on your clipboard into a PDF and put the PDF back on your clipboard, ready to paste or attach.
author: gustavocaiano

commands.name: clipboard-to-pdf
commands.title: Clipboard Markdown to PDF
commands.description: Converts the Markdown on your clipboard into a PDF, saves it and copies the PDF file to your clipboard.

preferences.name: outputFolder
preferences.title: Save PDFs In
preferences.description: Folder where the generated PDFs are saved. Defaults to Downloads.

preferences.name: paperSize
preferences.title: Paper Size
preferences.description: Page size of the generated PDF.

preferences.name: afterGenerating
preferences.title: After Generating
preferences.description: The PDF is always saved and copied to the clipboard. Optionally open it as well.
